simple.meaning: שֵׁת (shêth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “six(-th).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Ezra 6:15. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֵׁת (H8353) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שֵׁת (shêth) / H8353 is traced through Ezra 6:15, Daniel 3:1 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

timeline.evidenceText: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was sixty cubits,* A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. and its width six cubits. He set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
